exercise__records_help_intro: Only ticked working, drop and failure sets count. Warm-ups are shown in history but excluded from all numbers. Records are recomputed when sessions are edited or deleted. Dates show the first session to achieve each best.
exercise__help_weight: The greatest effective weight in a counted set. Weighted exercises use logged weight; bodyweight exercises use your bodyweight, minus assistance where applicable, with a minimum of zero.
exercise__help_one_rm: Estimated one-rep maximum using Brzycki: effective weight × 36 ÷ (37 − reps). Only sets of 1–12 reps qualify.
exercise__help_set_volume: The greatest effective weight × reps in one counted set.
exercise__help_session_volume: The greatest sum of effective weight × reps for this exercise in one session.
exercise__help_duration: The longest duration in one counted set.
exercise__help_distance: The longest distance in one counted set.
exercise__help_pace: The fastest distance ÷ duration in one counted set, in metres per second. Higher is faster.
exercise__help_reps: The greatest effective weight lifted for each rep count from 1 to 12.
